part.text:
Added Handlebars-based templating with layouts and partials to the static site generator:

- **`src/templates.ts`** — new `TemplateEngine`: loads `templates/partials/*.hbs` as Handlebars partials, renders a named page template, then wraps it in a named layout via `{{{body}}}`. Falls back to built-in default strings when a template/layout file or the whole `./templates` dir is missing, so builds still work with no templates present.
- **`templates/`** — `page.hbs` (default template), `post.hbs` (example alt template), `index.hbs`, `layouts/default.hbs`, and `partials/header.hbs`, `footer.hbs`, `nav.hbs`.
- **`src/page.ts`** — `Page` now carries `template`/`layout`; `src/site.ts` reads `template:`/`layout:` from frontmatter (default `page`/`default`), instantiates `TemplateEngine`, and renders pages and the generated index through it instead of the old hardcoded `renderPageHtml`/`renderIndexHtml`.
- **`src/cli.ts`** — added `--templates <dir>` option (default `./templates`); `BuildOptions.templatesDir` is optional for backward compatibility.
- Added `handlebars` to `package.json` dependencies (it was already a transitive dep, now promoted properly).
- Added `src/templates.test.ts` (engine unit tests: body-into-layout, unescaped HTML, alternate layouts, partials, fallbacks) and new `site.test.ts` cases (frontmatter template/layout selection, partial rendering end-to-end, index template, fallback with no templates dir). All prior tests untouched and still pass.

Verified with a manual build of the existing `content/` — output HTML renders through header/nav/footer partials and the default layout as expected — and `tsc` compiles clean.
